title: Mariners Win Walk-Off Game Against Giants
summary: The Seattle Mariners won a game against the San Francisco Giants in extra innings. The Mariners' walk-off sacrifice fly in the 10th inning secured their 4-3 victory. This win marks an important moment for the team.
summary_points: The Seattle Mariners played against the San Francisco Giants in a baseball game.
The game went into extra innings before the Mariners scored the winning run.
This is the first time the Mariners have won a game in this manner.
The win marks an important moment for the team's season.
The outcome of the game may impact the Mariners' playoff chances.

summary_points_hi: सीनेटल मारिनर्स ने गियर बदलकर गiants के खिलाफ बेसबॉल मैच खेला.
गेम में अतिरिक्त इनिंगों में जाने से पहले, मारिनर्स ने वinning रन स्कोर किया।
यह मारिनर्स की पहली जीत है इस तरह से।
